user.title: Connect Enable Banking
user.description: Enter your Production application details. Store the PEM key locally on Home Assistant. Add YOUR_HTTPS_HA_ADDRESS/api/enable_banking/callback to the application redirect URLs.

data.key_path: Absolute path to the PEM key on HA
data.base_url: Home Assistant HTTPS address (without a path)

bank.title: Select your bank
bank.description: Select a bank from the current Enable Banking list. When renewing authorization, select the same bank.

authorize.title: Authorize access at your bank
authorize.description: [Open bank authorization]({auth_url}) in a new tab. If the link is missing or does not work, copy the authorization URL from the first field and open it in a new tab. After approving access, copy the ENTIRE return URL from the browser into the callback field below. Keep this form open. Do not share these URLs.

data.authorization_url: Authorization URL — copy and open in a new tab
data.callback_url: Full return URL after bank authorization

accounts.title: Select accounts to count
accounts.description: The counters add up the selected accounts at this bank.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTPS address without a path, query, fragment or credentials.
error.invalid_key: Cannot read the PEM file. Check its absolute path and permissions.
error.no_banks: The API returned no Polish AIS banks.
error.invalid_callback: Invalid return URL or state. Paste the entire return URL from this authorization attempt, including code and state.
error.wrong_bank: Select the bank belonging to this integration entry.
error.api_error: Enable Banking rejected the request: {error_detail}. Report this code when requesting help.
error.invalid_auth: Enable Banking returned HTTP 401. Check that the application ID and private key belong to the same application. Also check the HA clock.
error.access_denied: Enable Banking returned HTTP 403 ({error_detail}). Check application activation and AIS permissions.
error.redirect_not_allowed: The redirect URL is not allowed. Add your exact HA HTTPS address followed by /api/enable_banking/callback to the Enable Banking application.
error.rate_limited: Request limit exceeded (HTTP 429). Wait before retrying.
error.invalid_key_format: The file is not a usable private RSA PEM key, or is encrypted. Use the key generated for this application.
error.request_timeout: The request to Enable Banking timed out. Try again later.
error.network_error: HA cannot reach Enable Banking. Check DNS, internet access and TLS certificates.
error.unexpected_response: Unexpected API response or invalid data format. Check the enable_banking log and report the issue.

abort.no_accounts: No accounts returned. Link your accounts to this application in Enable Banking and retry.
abort.authorization_failed: Could not create a session. Restart configuration to obtain a new authorization code.
abort.already_configured: This bank is already configured for this application.
